description: Formal multi-dimensional task acceptance specification and predicate architecture.

architecture.core_principle: A task may PASS only when every mandatory dimension passes. A task cannot PASS merely because 'something succeeded', 'a file exists', 'a plan looked correct', or 'a capability returned success'.

INTENT_CORRECTNESS.question: Did Astra understand what the user asked?

ENTITY_CORRECTNESS.question: Did Astra resolve the correct real-world entities (applications, files, controls)?

MODALITY_CORRECTNESS.question: Did Astra use the requested interaction modality (UI vs direct)?

PLAN_RELEVANCE.question: Does every consequential step plausibly advance a mandatory goal predicate?

EXECUTION_REALITY.question: Did the actions actually occur on the physical machine?

STATE_TRANSITION_CORRECTNESS.question: Did the world change as expected from pre-state to post-state?

OUTPUT_CORRECTNESS.question: Is the final artifact/state semantically correct and non-empty?

SIDE_EFFECT_CLEANLINESS.question: Were there unrequested consequential actions or window mutations?

RESOURCE_CLEANUP.question: Were Astra-owned transient resources, handles, and processes cleaned?

SECURITY_COMPLIANCE.question: Did all consequential operations pass authoritative security mediation?

PROVENANCE.question: Can the result be tied causally to the actual production execution without fabrication?

application_discovery_goal.name: intended_app_identity_matches_resolved
application_discovery_goal.failure_reason: Resolved application is semantically distinct from requested target

application_discovery_goal.name: unambiguous_or_clarified
application_discovery_goal.failure_reason: Selected candidate has ambiguous competitor without user clarification

document_ui_goal.name: requested_app_open
document_ui_goal.failure_reason: Target application process or top-level window was not present

document_ui_goal.name: editable_surface_observed
document_ui_goal.failure_reason: No focused editable document surface found in application

document_ui_goal.name: requested_content_observed_in_surface
document_ui_goal.failure_reason: Target text was not present in the application editor surface

document_ui_goal.name: application_save_flow_observed
document_ui_goal.evidence_source: Save As Dialog HWND + filename entry + commit
document_ui_goal.failure_reason: Direct filesystem bypass used instead of native application Save workflow

document_ui_goal.name: requested_artifact_exists_and_matches
document_ui_goal.failure_reason: Artifact is missing, 0 bytes, or content does not match semantic contract

browser_goal.name: browser_context_exists
browser_goal.failure_reason: No browser instance was active or controlled

browser_goal.name: requested_navigation_observed
browser_goal.evidence_source: Browser address bar / DOM location / CDP URL
browser_goal.failure_reason: Browser URL does not match requested destination

browser_goal.name: requested_interaction_observed
browser_goal.failure_reason: Requested web interaction did not occur on page

multi_application_goal.name: two_independent_apps_participate
multi_application_goal.evidence_source: Distinct process PIDs and window HWNDs for App A and App B
multi_application_goal.failure_reason: Fewer than two distinct application contexts participated in execution

multi_application_goal.name: causal_information_transfer
multi_application_goal.evidence_source: App A extraction -> agent intermediate state -> App B entry
multi_application_goal.failure_reason: Data entered into App B was not derived from App A observation

side_effect_cleanliness.name: no_unrequested_consequential_actions
side_effect_cleanliness.failure_reason: Consequential actions occurred that did not advance any goal predicate
